battle.name: 里夫戰爭
battle.brief: 里夫戰爭是西班牙殖民軍與摩洛哥北部里夫部族在1920年至1926年間發生的衝突，涉及殖民統治、地方武裝反抗及西班牙維持北非控制權的目標。里夫部族武裝曾配備惠氏步槍（Winchester Model 1873），此型自1873年起列裝，屬美國制式步槍，並體現殖民擴張與地方反抗。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: 惠氏步槍曾列入美國陸軍的制式步兵武器，編入步槍序列供部隊配發，是早期後膛步槍的代表型號。

countries: 里夫戰爭的戰區位於北摩洛哥的里夫山區，山地西接菲斯、塔扎與法屬摩洛哥，東通梅利利亞、奈多爾等西班牙控制區，橫跨海岸港口與內陸高原之間。1920年時，主要交戰方是西班牙王國與由多個里夫戰鬥團體構成的聯盟；後者已由阿卜杜勒·克里姆建立集中指揮、仍保留地方軍事單位的政治軍事架構，並於1921年至1922年間形成未被國際普遍承認的里夫共和國。法國在1920年尚非里夫主要交戰者，但已依據在摩洛哥的勢力範圍安排保護西屬保護國；1921年阿努亞爾慘敗後，法國於1923年正式出兵，與西班牙共同對抗里夫軍。法軍主要從菲斯、塔扎方向展開，西班牙軍則以梅利利亞為主要後勤港，向西迪穆薩、穆薩山脈及阿爾胡塞馬一帶推進。因此，這不是單一西班牙對單一國家的速決戰役，而是西班牙先承擔主要壓力、法國後來以更多兵力與更完整後勤介入的長期戰爭。
countriesEn: The theater of the Rif War lay in the Rif mountains of northern Morocco, where the western approaches connected Fez, Taza, and French Morocco with the Spanish-held Mediterranean ports of Melilla and Nador. In 1920, the principal belligerents were the Kingdom of Spain and a confederation of Rif fighting groups under a central command developed by Abd el-Krim while retaining local military units. This structure would become the self-proclaimed, but not broadly internationally recognized, Rif Republic between 1921 and 1922. France was not yet a principal belligerent in the Rif in 1920, although its established spheres of influence in Morocco included protection for the Spanish protectorate. Following Spain’s catastrophic defeat at Annual in 1921, France entered the war directly in 1923 and fought alongside Spain against the Rif forces. The French operation unfolded principally from Fez and Taza, while Spain used Melilla as its principal supply port and drove toward Sidi Musa, the Jebel Musa massif, and Al Hoceima. The conflict was therefore not a quick duel between Spain and one established state. Spain initially bore most of the military burden, and France later entered with greater manpower and a more complete logistical system.
people: 阿卜杜勒·克里姆是里夫軍隊最重要的統帥。他不是只帶領一次突擊，而是以部落會議、使者、騎士與步兵協同網把分散的里夫戰鬥團體連成能夠封鎖道路、分割縱隊和轉用俘獲武器的軍隊；阿卜杜勒·阿里與穆罕默德・阿爾・阿菲菲則在1925年至1927年先後率領野外部隊作戰。西班牙方面，達馬索・貝倫格爾是推動前進的高級專員，曼努埃爾・費爾南德斯・西爾維斯特以果斷而急促的作戰計畫主導1921年攻勢，試圖在里夫核心山地建立新陣地並解除各部落的武裝。他的計畫建立在山地駐軍脆弱、里夫各部已受控制的判斷上，情報與地形估計卻完全相反。戰役崩潰後，何塞・桑胡爾霍在西迪穆薩及梅利利亞外圍的巴萊爾托一帶收攏後方部隊，以縱隊掩護和陣地阻擋追兵，使部分西班牙兵力得以返回海岸。法國在1923年由路易・德・戈伊斯・德・梅澤拉克負責法軍最高指揮，菲利普・貝當指揮師級部隊並於奧德拉維塔作戰；1926年大規模攻勢則由貝當統籌。西班牙在1925年和1927年的攻勢主要由費爾南多・普里莫・德・里韋拉指揮。1927年11月28日，阿卜杜勒・克里姆向法軍司令馬夏爾・梅爾蘭投降，結束了他直接組織和指揮的戰爭階段。
peopleEn: Abd el-Krim was the principal commander of the Rif forces. He did more than lead isolated attacks: through tribal councils, messengers, mountedmen, and infantry networks, he joined dispersed Rif fighting groups into an army capable of blocking roads, splitting columns, and deploying captured weapons. Ahmed ben Ali and Mohammed el-Afifi commanded field formations during the campaigns of 1925 through 1927. On the Spanish side, Dámaso Berenguer was the senior official driving the advance. Manuel Fernández Silvestre directed the rapid offensive of 1921 with the intention of establishing positions in the central Rif and disarming its tribal groups. His plan rested on the assumption that the mountain garrisons were weak and that the Rif had already been brought under control, but both the intelligence and the terrain assessment were badly wrong. After the collapse, José Sanjurjo gathered rear-guard troops around Sidi Musa and Ballelerto outside Melilla, using blocking positions and covered withdrawals to delay the pursuit and allow part of the Spanish force to reach the coast. In 1923, Louis de Goÿs de Mézeyrac held overall command of the French expedition, while Philippe Pétain commanded division-level operations, including the Battle of Oued Laouita. Pétain directed the much larger offensive of 1926. Fernando Primo de Rivera led the principal Spanish offensives in 1925 and 1927. On 28 November 1927, Abd el-Krim surrendered to the French commander Martial Merlin, bringing the phase personally directed and organized by him to an end.
kits: 1921年的西班牙正規步兵主要使用七毫米Mauser Model 1889步槍，即Gewehr 88型，採五發橋夾與可拆卸彈匣；部分西班牙摩洛哥部隊仍配發較舊的Mannlicher Model 1895八毫米步槍。里夫戰鬥團體從西班牙方面取得Mauser Model 1889、Mauser Model 1893卡賓槍及相應七毫米彈藥，也使用從北非軍械流動中取得的各類舊式步槍。西班牙營級火力包括Maxim Model 1888/89與Hotchkiss Model 1914機關槍，後者使用八毫米八乘五十R彈藥和三十發彈帶；里夫軍在攻勢中曾奪取Hotchkiss機槍、七十五毫米炮與大量野戰彈藥，但高山道路使這些裝備的供應和回收十分困難。法軍在1923年後以Lebel Model 1886八乘三十二R步槍為制式武器，同樣使用五發橋夾，並配Hotchkiss Model 1914機槍。西班牙使用七十五毫米Schneider Model 1913野戰炮；法軍則有七十五毫米Canon de 75 modèle 1919野戰炮及一百二十毫米Canon de 120 mle 1916榴彈炮，後者配備七十五乘五十四點五R的七十五毫米炮彈。法軍在摩洛哥還使用Berliet CBA一點五噸貨車、Renault FT-17輕坦克與Breguet 14轟炸機。法軍用道路、鐵路、貨車和畜力轉運把彈藥、糧食與飲水送過山區；西班牙後勤同樣依靠梅利利亞港、獸力車隊和臨時堆積點。所有提及的槍炮、裝甲車與飛機均已在1920年以前列入軍械。
kitsEn: Spanish regular infantry in 1921 were principally armed with the seven-millimeter Mauser Model 1889 rifle, also known as the Gewehr 88, using five-round en-bloc clips and detachable magazines. Some Spanish units in Morocco still received the older Mannlicher Model 1895 rifle in eight-millimeter caliber. Rif fighting groups acquired Mauser Model 1889 rifles, Mauser Model 1893 carbines, and matching seven-millimeter ammunition from the Spanish forces, as well as older service rifles circulating through North Africa. Spanish battalion-level firepower included the Maxim Model 1888/89 and the Hotchkiss Model 1914 machine gun. The latter fired 8×50R ammunition from thirty-round belts, and the Rif captured Hotchkiss guns, seventy-five-millimeter artillery, and substantial quantities of field ammunition during their offensives, although mountain roads made the supply and recovery of such matériel extremely difficult. After 1923, French troops used the Lebel Model 1886 rifle in 8×32R caliber with five-round clips and also relied on the Hotchkiss Model 1914. Spain employed the seventy-five-millimeter Schneider Model 1913 field gun, while France fielded the Canon de 75 modèle 1919 and the Canon de 120 mle 1916 howitzer; the French seventy-five-millimeter gun used 75×54.5R ammunition. French forces in Morocco also used Berliet CBA one-and-a-half-ton trucks, Renault FT-17 light tanks, and Breguet 14 bombers. Their supply system combined roads, railways, motor trucks, and animal transport to move ammunition, food, and water across the mountains. The Spanish system likewise depended on Melilla, mule-drawn wagons, and temporary supply dumps. Every weapon, vehicle, and aircraft named here had entered service before 1920.
tactics: 阿努亞爾作戰暴露了西班牙攻勢的主要弱點：主力沿山道行進，縱隊前後相距數十公里，步兵營、補充營、野戰炮和行李隊分置不同位置，前方營壘尚未完成連續野戰工事便遭里夫軍集中攻擊。1921年7月17日晨，里夫各團體利用峽谷、高地和道路狹窄處封住縱隊，先以小股兵力牽制西班牙前哨，再將主力壓向中央營區；炮兵陣地和補給堆場失守後，西爾維斯特下令總退，縱隊因道路阻塞、馬匹消耗和連續行軍而迅速瓦解。桑胡爾霍率的後方部隊利用狹路與陣地逐段阻滯追擊，避免了全軍被同一道路一次截斷。法軍在1923年後改採法軍在摩洛哥逐步成熟的組合兵種方法：七十五毫米炮先行壓制，步兵以小組交替躍進，工兵清理道路和障礙，後方由縱列車隊保障；航空隊負責觀察和標定射擊目標。里夫軍則由大規模正面會戰轉向分散游擊、夜間移動、隘口封鎖、伏擊與暫時占領高地，仍以地方團體保持基層作戰能力，但統一供應和協同射擊變得更困難。1925年後，西班牙與法國的攻勢都採用步兵、炮兵、工兵和航空協同，逐個奪取山脊與路口，再以道路、窄軌鐵路和畜力運輸鞏固補給線；Renault FT-17多作道路警戒和據點支援，而不是企圖單獨突破山地。里夫軍最後仍能依靠熟悉山勢的部隊局部反擊，卻因法西兩面夾擊、彈藥受制和縱隊接連被切斷，無法再保有1921年時的攻勢能力。
tacticsEn: The operation at Annual exposed the central weakness of the Spanish offensive. The main body advanced along mountain tracks with columns separated by tens of kilometers, while infantry battalions, depot companies, field guns, and baggage trains occupied different positions. Before the forward camps had been consolidated into continuous field fortifications, the Rif attacked in force. On the morning of 17 July 1921, Rif groups used ravines, heights, and constricted roads to close the Spanish columns. Small forces fixed outposts before the main body was driven against the central camp. The loss of the artillery positions and supply dumps forced Silvestre to order a general withdrawal. The retreat deteriorated because of blocked roads, exhausted animals, and the continuous movement of a column that had lost coherence. Sanjurjo’s rear guard used narrow passes and blocking positions to slow the pursuit, preventing the entire army from being severed on one road. After 1923, the French applied the combined-arms method they were developing in Morocco: seventy-five-millimeter guns prepared the objective, infantry advanced by bounded groups, engineers cleared roads and obstacles, and organized transport trains sustained the advance. French aviation supplied observation and gunfire correction. The Rif shifted from large conventional battles toward dispersed operations, night movement, control of passes, ambushes, and temporary occupation of heights. Local formations still sustained the fighting, but unified supply and coordinated fire became increasingly difficult. From 1925 onward, both Spain and France advanced with infantry, artillery, engineers, and aviation, taking ridges and road junctions one at a time and then securing supply routes by road, narrow-gauge railway, and animal transport. Renault FT-17 tanks were used chiefly for road security and support of isolated strongpoints rather than as a means of breaking through the mountains by themselves. Rif troops could still mount localized counterattacks, but French and Spanish attacks from two axes, ammunition constraints, and repeated severing of their columns deprived them of the offensive capacity they had displayed in 1921.
data: 里夫戰爭的完整軍事歷程通常由1920年算至1927年；1920年，西班牙把解除里夫各部武裝與向內陸設立 posts 合併進行，部隊由梅利利亞沿西迪穆薩方向深入，里夫聯軍則退入山區並切斷公路。1921年7月上旬，西爾維斯特的主力經梅利利亞、西迪穆薩和阿努亞爾方向約四十餘公里的山道推進，補給與炮隊落在很後方。7月17日拂曉，里夫軍攻破前哨、壓入中央營地並奪取野戰炮與堆積物；西班牙縱隊在山路上被切成數段，經西迪穆薩方向退向梅利利亞，桑胡爾霍在巴萊爾托一帶收束殘部。這一事件通常稱為阿努亞爾之敗，1921年的主戰局至此結束。1921年至1922年，里夫方面把軍事勝利轉為更完整的聯盟、供應和山地控制；法國則以1923年4月28日的奧德拉維塔戰役投入直接干預，法軍在德・戈伊斯總指揮、貝當指揮下擊退里夫軍並打通菲斯方向的道路，法軍其後控制菲斯與塔扎之間的走廊。西班牙在阿努亞爾後重整，1925年6月於塔克西爾特方向發動攻勢，步兵、炮兵、工兵與航空協同奪取北里夫的高地和穆薩山區陣地，重新取得攻勢。1926年4月，法軍在貝當指揮下由菲斯、塔扎向中央高原推進；西班牙軍同時由梅利利亞及阿爾胡塞馬方向施壓，法軍出動Renault FT-17坦克、飛機和七十五毫米炮支援步兵，法西兩條縱隊雖未完全統一指揮，卻迫使里夫軍不能集中對付單一方向。入秋後法軍進入阿季迪爾一帶，西班牙縱隊也打通沿海山脊，里夫軍的補給、命令傳遞與突擊縱隊被分割。1927年，西班牙沿梅利利亞後勤軸線逐步奪回切菲亞特等山地據點；到11月中旬，西軍占領提斯克拉德，包圍圈只剩法軍控制下的最後出口。阿卜杜勒・克里姆於11月28日向馬夏爾・梅爾蘭投降，野戰抵抗由此終止。從1921年一度把西班牙軍逐回海岸，到1923年後引來法軍直接參戰，再到1926年至1927年以更長補給線包圍里夫軍，這條時間線顯示控制的不只是幾處山口，而是能否持續供應炮彈、糧食、馬匹、傷病後送與命令。
dataEn: The complete military chronology of the Rif War is normally dated from 1920 through 1927. In 1920, Spain combined the disarmament of the Rif groups with the establishment of forward posts in the interior. Its troops moved inland from Melilla toward Sidi Musa, while the Rif federation withdrew into the mountains and cut the roads. In early July 1921, Silvestre’s main force advanced along roughly forty-odd kilometers of mountain track through Melilla, Sidi Musa, and the direction of Annual, with its guns and supply dumps far behind the leading formations. At dawn on 17 July, the Rif broke through the outposts, drove into the central camp, and seized the field guns and supply dumps. The Spanish columns were cut apart on the narrow roads and withdrew toward Melilla by way of Sidi Musa, while Sanjurjo gathered part of the rear force around Ballelerto. The episode is known as the Disaster of Annual, and it ended the principal Spanish phase of 1921. Between 1921 and 1922, the Rif converted its battlefield victory into a more complete federation, supply network, and control of the mountain positions. France entered directly in 1923. At the Battle of Oued Laouita on 28 April, French forces under the overall command of de Goÿs and the operational leadership of Pétain defeated the Rif and opened the roads from Fez. French troops subsequently controlled the Fez–Taza corridor. Spain reorganized after Annual and launched an offensive at Taxdirt in June 1925. Infantry, artillery, engineers, and aviation working together recaptured positions in the northern Rif and the Jebel Musa massif, restoring the Spanish initiative. In April 1926, Pétain’s French offensive advanced from Fez and Taza toward the central plateau, while Spanish forces exerted pressure from Melilla and Al Hoceima. The French employed Renault FT-17 tanks, aircraft, and seventy-five-millimeter guns in support of infantry. Although the two columns did not operate under a single headquarters, the French advance from one direction and the Spanish pressure from another prevented the Rif from concentrating against either axis. French troops entered the Ajdir area by autumn, while Spanish columns secured the coastal ridges. The Rif supply system, command links, and striking columns were progressively separated. In 1927, Spain drove forward along the Melilla supply axis and recovered mountain positions including Chefiat. By mid-November, Spanish troops had occupied Tiskrad, leaving only an exit controlled by the French. Abd el-Krim surrendered to Martial Merlin on 28 November, ending organized field resistance. The sequence from the Spanish withdrawal toward the coast in 1921, through French intervention in 1923, to the encirclement of 1926 and 1927 shows that the decisive issue was not the possession of a few passes alone. It was the ability to sustain artillery ammunition, food, animals, evacuation, and command across the mountain system.
cause: 戰爭的第一層原因是西班牙在摩洛哥保護國的軍事擴張。1920年前後，西班牙企圖以駐軍和解除武裝控制里夫山地，卻面對一個已能跨越地方界線協調兵源的里夫聯軍。里夫軍的抵抗重點是守住水源、隘口和道路，使西班牙推進部隊無法取得連續補給；阿卜杜勒・克里姆則把這種地方防禦轉成集中攻勢。第二層原因是西班牙對敵情與地形的錯誤估計。西爾維斯特相信阿努亞爾一帶可以迅速占領，計畫中的先鋒、炮隊、營壘和總部卻因追求速度而彼此分離，隊形一旦在狹窄山地被切斷，後方命令便無法抵達前線。第三層原因是法國在阿努亞爾後改變態度。法國不僅要保護自己的摩洛哥區域，也不能再容忍西班牙保護國崩潰，因為西軍若被逐回海岸，法軍將獨自面對里夫壓力。因此，1923年法軍參戰不是對1921年事件的附帶反應，而是主動改變力量平衡的決定。山區道路、缺水、酷熱與有限的可展開地面，則讓遠程火炮優勢無法完全展開，使任何一方都必須付出時間、畜力與補給成本。
causeEn: The first layer of causation was the Spanish military expansion of the Moroccan protectorate. Around 1920, Spain sought to control the Rif highlands through garrisons and disarmament, but it faced a Rif confederation capable of coordinating troops across local boundaries. The Rif objective was to retain control of water sources, passes, and roads so that advancing Spanish formations could not obtain continuous supply. Abd el-Krim converted this local defensive system into concentrated offensives. The second cause was Spain’s mistaken estimate of the enemy and terrain. Silvestre believed that the Annual area could be occupied rapidly, but the plan separated the vanguard, guns, camps, and headquarters in pursuit of speed. Once the formation was cut in narrow mountain country, rear-area commands could no longer reach the front. The third cause was France’s changed policy after Annual. France needed to protect its own Moroccan zone and could no longer accept the collapse of the Spanish protectorate, because a Spanish withdrawal toward the coast would have left French forces alone against the Rif. French entry in 1923 was therefore not a minor addition to the campaign of 1921; it was a deliberate alteration of the balance of forces. Mountain roads, scarce water, severe heat, and limited room for deployment reduced the full advantage of long-range artillery. Every side consequently had to spend time, animal transport, and supply in order to advance.
impact: 阿努亞爾之敗首先改變了西班牙在摩洛哥的作戰方法。舊式攻勢把前進速度視為接近里夫核心的唯一手段，卻證明炮兵、補充隊和總部一旦落在後方，整個縱隊便會失去協同；1925年後的西班牙攻勢因此更重視道路鞏固、工兵、連續炮火和逐點占領。貝倫格爾內閣在1921年慘敗後的政治崩潰也促使馬德里改組對摩洛哥的管理與軍隊，1926年至1927年的行動因而比西爾維斯特的急進推進更接近 methodical siege。對法國而言，摩洛哥成為觀察獨立空軍、裝甲部隊和遠程砲兵如何配合的實戰場所；Breguet 14航空隊、Renault FT-17坦克與七十五毫米炮的有限使用，顯示機械化力量能提高道路控制與據點支援，卻不能在沒有 suitable roads 的山地取代步兵和後勤。里夫軍則證明分散團體可在缺乏統一火力的情況下摧毀一支裝備較好的縱隊，同時也顯示單靠集中突擊不足以對抗能持續運作的法西聯合作戰。戰爭的長期結果是西班牙重新獲得 eastern Rif 的軍事主動權，法國在西側占據更穩固地位，而里夫聯軍原本可獨力運作的政治軍事體系被拆散。這些變化延續到之後的殖民戰爭，也使阿努阿爾與其後法軍介入成為北非軍事史反覆研究的案例。
impactEn: The Disaster of Annual first changed the way Spain fought in Morocco. The earlier offensive treated speed as the principal means of reaching the heart of the Rif, but it proved that once artillery, depot companies, and headquarters were left behind, an entire column could lose coordination. Spanish offensives after 1925 consequently placed greater emphasis on securing roads, engineers, continuous artillery preparation, and the capture of objectives one at a time. The political collapse of the Berenguer government after the defeat of 1921 also led Madrid to reorganize its administration and forces in Morocco, making the operations of 1926 and 1927 considerably more methodical than Silvestre’s rapid advance. For France, Morocco became a practical theater for observing the coordination of an independent air service, armor, and long-range artillery. The limited employment of Breguet 14 aircraft, Renault FT-17 tanks, and seventy-five-millimeter guns showed that mechanized forces could improve road control and support isolated positions, but could not replace infantry and logistics where suitable roads did not exist. The Rif forces demonstrated that dispersed groups could destroy a better-equipped column even without unified firepower. They also showed that concentrated raids alone could not answer a Franco-Spanish operation capable of sustaining itself. The long-term result was restored Spanish control in the eastern Rif, a more secure French position in the west, and the breakup of the Rif military-political system that had previously operated on its own. These changes carried into later colonial warfare and made Annual and the subsequent French intervention enduring subjects of North African military history.
result: 里夫戰爭的結果必須按兩個階段判斷。1921年7月，西班牙在阿努亞爾遭致決定性的戰術與作戰失敗，前進縱隊被逐回梅利利亞方向，炮兵、補給與大量裝備落入里夫軍之手；阿卜杜勒・克里姆由此取得主動權，並在1922年前後建立里夫共和國的軍事政治架構。這個成果沒有維持到戰爭終點，因為法國在1923年直接投入遠比西班牙完整的兵力與後勤，於1925年切斷里夫軍的部分集中，1926年再以菲斯、塔扎方向的法軍主攻和梅利利亞方向的西班牙攻勢形成兩面夾擊。1927年，西班牙部隊占領切菲亞特、提斯克拉德等山地據點，11月28日阿卜杜勒・克里姆向法軍投降，里夫軍的野戰指揮體系至此瓦解。西班牙保住並重新控制 eastern Rif 的主要陣地，法國則鞏固菲斯、塔扎與西部方向，兩國仍各以本國勢力範圍維持保護國安排；阿卜杜勒・克里姆隨後被法方拘禁和判處，交換條件不再是里夫軍可自行決定。因此，1920年至1927年的完整結果並非西班牙自始即敗，也非里夫在1921年奪取拉 culminated victory：前者於1921年敗得最重，後者的軍事成果則在法國直接參戰、補給條件與兩國協同作戰面前逐步耗盡，最終以包圍、據點失守和指揮官投降收場。
resultEn: The outcome of the Rif War must be understood in two stages. In July 1921, Spain suffered a decisive tactical and operational defeat at Annual. Its advancing columns were driven back toward Melilla, and artillery, supplies, and a large quantity of equipment fell into Rif hands. Abd el-Krim gained the initiative and built the military-political framework of the Rif Republic around 1922. That result did not endure to the end of the war. France entered directly in 1923 with substantially greater manpower and a more complete logistical system, restricted the Rif concentration in 1925, and in 1926 combined the main French advance from Fez and Taza with Spanish pressure from Melilla. In 1927, Spanish forces took mountain positions including Chefiat and Tiskrad. Abd el-Krim surrendered to the French on 28 November, and the field command system of the Rif army broke down. Spain retained and regained the main positions of the eastern Rif, while France consolidated Fez, Taza, and the western approaches. Both powers continued to administer their respective protectorate zones, and Abd el-Krim was subsequently detained and tried by France. The terms were no longer subject to determination by the Rif army. The complete result from 1920 through 1927 was therefore neither an unbroken Spanish failure nor an unqualified Rif victory after 1921. Spain suffered its gravest reverse in 1921, while the Rif military gains were gradually exhausted by direct French participation, improved French supply, and combined French-Spanish operations. The campaign ended with encirclement, the loss of strongpoints, and the surrender of its commander.
